tie_lemmas.L0: MINSD/MAXSD returns its source operand on an equality or unordered comparison; equal finite nonzero operands have identical bits.
tie_lemmas.L1: The production deck has finite, nonnegative layer thickness and the O10 entry has sz_i >= rn_simin = 0.1; TEMP1 therefore has t_i-rt0 <= -rTmlt*rn_simin = -0.0054 K.
tie_lemmas.L2: ABS produces +0 for either signed-zero input, and comparisons do not observe a zero sign.
tie_lemmas.L3: The unrolled line-644 object emits MIN(0,zds) as (dst,src)=(zds,0) except in layer 9, and emits the outer MAX as (MIN,floor) except in layers 9 and 10; the committed bit-changing plants pin both splits.
